Class CriticNet

java.lang.Object
dev.swordai.core.rl.CriticNet
public final class CriticNet extends Object
Value network. It reads the actor's vector input plus privileged ground truth, and is used only to compute advantages during training; it never influences what the agent does at play time.

    • taskIn

      private final Dense taskIn
      Which kind of fight it is (the opponent, a drill, a replay of a lost fight), one-hot, into the first layer; null when the critic is not told. The opponents differ more than anything else the critic sees in what a fight is worth (a no-knockback bot deals three times what a runner does), and without this it has to work that out from the fight itself: up to 21 October it explained under half of the returns. The actor is never told; the critic may be, it does not play (asymmetric actor-critic, Pinto et al. 2018).
